name: dev_stateless_conversion
description: Small stateless API with no supporting actor or persistent state.
resource_constraints_text: Deploy a Docker image on AWS Linux VMs in the Seoul region. The monthly budget is 100 USD. High availability is not required.

classified.text: API consumers convert values between supported length, weight, and temperature units.
API consumers retrieve the list of supported units and conversion formulas.
The service rejects unsupported units and malformed numeric values with an explanatory error.
Conversion responses shall complete within 300 milliseconds at the 95th percentile under 20 requests per second.
The service shall not store server-side application data.
The application shall run as a Docker container on a Linux VM and expose a health endpoint.
